13: // Description: RISC-V IOMMU *banked* (two-lane) transaction controller wrapper.
14: //
15: //   This module wires two `rv_iommu_trans_ctl_wrap` instances with read admission
16: //   ("banks") behind an incoming AXI4 demultiplexer and in front of an outgoing
17: //   AXI4 multiplexer.  The bank of a transaction is selected by the immutable
18: //   ORIGINAL AXI ID bit `BankIdBit` (never by the device/stream id):
19: //
20: //     upstream  --axi_demux(2, sel=id[BankIdBit])--> bank0 / bank1
21: //               --axi_mux(2, high bank bit)--------> completion interface
22: //
23: //   Design notes / assumptions
24: //   --------------------------
25: //   * AXI IDs INSIDE each bank keep the ORIGINAL width.  The outgoing `axi_mux`
26: //     prepends exactly one bank bit as the MOST SIGNIFICANT ID bit.  That bit is
27: //     redundant with `id[BankIdBit]` (the incoming demux selected the bank with
28: //     that same bit), so it is stripped again for AW/AR.  For B/R the redundant
29: //     MSB is reconstructed from the ORIGINAL `id[BankIdBit]`, because the
30: //     external completion interface only ever carries ORIGINAL IDs.
31: //     ⇒ This assumes the external completion slave echoes AW/AR IDs unchanged.
32: //   * The two banks keep their own AW/AR/W FIFOs, their own AW-before-AR / W
33: //     gating and their own permission-error slave (each bank instantiates its
34: //     own `axi_err_slv`).  A wrapper admission guard delays new non-owner reads to avoid DMA
35: //     R-to-W dependency cycles. The legacy controller default is unchanged.
36: //   * MRIF is required to be disabled (MSI_DISABLED or MSI_BT_ONLY); the single
37: //     wrapper MRIF port is tied to zero.
38: //   * The legacy `rv_iommu::e3_ctl_t` observer is INCOMPATIBLE with two owners
39: //     (the old counters are not valid shared-owner counters).  `e3_o` therefore
40: //     returns ZERO except for `.quiet = !in_flight_o`.  NO legacy E3 observer
41: //     may consume any other field of this instance.
42: //   * The downstream translation engine must echo the `bank` field it received
43: //     in `trans_req_data_o` back in `trans_resp_data_i`.  At most one
44: //     translation is in flight per bank, which makes `bank` an unambiguous
45: //     lifecycle tag and guarantees the full bank-local header (retained at the
46: //     head of the bank AW/AR FIFO until COMPLETE) belongs to that tag.
